transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just need reliable internet for my coffee shop. The current one keeps dropping out when it's busy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand completely. When you say it drops out during busy times, are you talking about when you have lots of customers using wifi, or when you're processing credit card payments?
transcript.language_markers: Translated technical issue into business context

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both actually. Customers can't get online, and our payment system sometimes times out. It's really embarrassing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That would be frustrating for everyone. It sounds like you need more bandwidth - that's basically more capacity for internet traffic. Think of it like having wider pipes for water flow.
